versos.hebraico: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י הָל֞וֹךְ וְקָנִ֤יתָ לְּךָ֙ אֵז֣וֹר פִּשְׁתִּ֔ים וְשַׂמְתּ֖וֹ עַל־מָתְנֶ֑יךָ וּבַמַּ֖יִם לֹ֥א תְבִאֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: Thus says Yahweh to me, Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don’t put it in water.
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
controles.livre: Assim me disse o SENHOR: Vai, e compra para ti um cinto de linho, e o põe sobre teus lombos; e não o metas em água.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶקְנֶ֥ה אֶת־הָאֵז֖וֹר כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וָאָשִׂ֖ם עַל־מָתְנָֽי׃ס

controles.web: So I bought a belt according to Yahweh’s word, and put it on my waist.
controles.kjv: So I got a girdle according to the word of the Lord, and put it on my loins.
controles.livre: E comprei o cinto conforme à palavra do SENHOR, e o pus sobre meus lombos.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֧י דְבַר־יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י שֵׁנִ֥ית לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s word came to me the second time, saying,
controles.kjv: And the word of the Lord came unto me the second time, saying,
controles.livre: E veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR pela segunda vez, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: קַ֧ח אֶת־הָאֵז֛וֹר אֲשֶׁ֥ר קָנִ֖יתָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־מָתְנֶ֑יךָ וְקוּם֙ לֵ֣ךְ פְּרָ֔תָה וְטָמְנֵ֥הוּ שָׁ֖ם בִּנְקִ֥יק הַסָּֽלַע׃

controles.web: Take the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.
controles.kjv: Take the girdle that thou hast got, which is upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
controles.livre: Toma o cinto que compraste, que está sobre teus lombos, levanta-te, e vai ao Eufrates,  e ali o escondes na fenda de uma rocha.

versos.hebraico: וָאֵלֵ֕ךְ וָאֶטְמְנֵ֖הוּ בִּפְרָ֑ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אוֹתִֽי׃

controles.web: So I went, and hid it by the Euphrates, as Yahweh commanded me.
controles.kjv: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the Lord commanded me.
controles.livre: Então eu fui, e o escondi em Eufrates, como o SENHOR tinha me mandado.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֕י מִקֵּ֖ץ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י ק֚וּם לֵ֣ךְ פְּרָ֔תָה וְקַ֤ח מִשָּׁם֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֵז֔וֹר אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִ֖יךָ לְטָמְנוֹ־שָֽׁם׃

controles.web: After many days, Yahweh said to me, Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass after many days, that the Lord said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.
controles.livre: E sucedeu, que ao fim de muitos dias, o SENHOR me disse: Levanta-te, vai ao Eufrates, e toma dali o cinto que ali te mandei esconder.

versos.hebraico: וָאֵלֵ֣ךְ פְּרָ֔תָה וָאֶחְפֹּ֗ר וָֽאֶקַּח֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֵז֔וֹר מִן־הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־טְמַנְתִּ֣יו שָׁ֑מָּה וְהִנֵּה֙ נִשְׁחַ֣ת הָאֵז֔וֹר לֹ֥א יִצְלַ֖ח לַכֹּֽל׃פ

controles.web: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
controles.kjv: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
controles.livre: Então fui ao Eufrates, cavei, e tomei o cinto do lugar de onde o havia escondido; e eis que o cinto tinha se apodrecido; para nada mais prestava.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Then Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
controles.kjv: Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,
controles.livre: Então veio a mim palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כָּ֠כָה אַשְׁחִ֞ית אֶת־גְּא֧וֹן יְהוּדָ֛ה וְאֶת־גְּא֥וֹן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם הָרָֽב׃

controles.web: Thus says Yahweh, In this way I will mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Assim diz o SENHOR: assim farei apodrecer a arrogância de Judá, e a grande arrogância de Jerusalém,

versos.hebraico: הָעָם֩ הַזֶּ֨ה הָרָ֜ע הַֽמֵּאֲנִ֣ים׀ לִשְׁמ֣וֹעַ אֶת־דְּבָרַ֗י הַהֹֽלְכִים֙ בִּשְׁרִר֣וּת לִבָּ֔ם וַיֵּלְכ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְעָבְדָ֖ם וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם וִיהִי֙ כָּאֵז֣וֹר הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יִצְלַ֖ח לַכֹּֽל׃

controles.web: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and are gone after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this belt, which is profitable for nothing.
controles.kjv: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.
controles.livre: Este povo maligno, que recusa ouvir minhas palavras, que caminha conforme a teimosia de seu coração, e segue atrás de deuses estrangeiros para lhes servir, e para se encurvar a eles; e tal será como este cinto, que para nenhuma coisa presta.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ יִדְבַּ֨ק הָאֵז֜וֹר אֶל־מָתְנֵי־אִ֗ישׁ כֵּ֣ן הִדְבַּ֣קְתִּי אֵ֠לַי אֶת־כָּל־בֵּ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וְאֶת־כָּל־בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה לִֽהְי֥וֹת לִי֙ לְעָ֔ם וּלְשֵׁ֥ם וְלִתְהִלָּ֖ה וּלְתִפְאָ֑רֶת וְלֹ֖א שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃

controles.web: For as the belt clings to the waist of a man, so have I caused to cling to me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, says Yahweh; that they may be to me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
controles.kjv: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the Lord; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
controles.livre: Porque assim como o cinto está junto aos lombos do homem, assim fiz juntar a mim toda a casa de Israel e toda a casa de Judá,diz o SENHOR, para que me fossem por povo e por nome, e por louvor e por glória; porém não quiseram escutar.

versos.hebraico: וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗הס כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כָּל־נֵ֖בֶל יִמָּ֣לֵא יָ֑יִן וְאָמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ הֲיָדֹ֨עַ֙ לֹ֣א נֵדַ֔ע כִּ֥י כָל־נֵ֖בֶל יִמָּ֥לֵא יָֽיִן׃

controles.web: Therefore you shall speak to them this word: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall tell you, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
controles.kjv: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
controles.livre: Por isso dize-lhes esta palavra: Assim diz o SENHOR, Deus de Israel: Todo odre se encherá de vinho. E te dirão: Por acaso nós não sabemos muito bem que todo odre se encherá de vinho?

versos.hebraico: וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנְנִ֣י מְמַלֵּ֣א אֶת־כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֪רֶץ הַזֹּ֟את וְאֶת־הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הַיֹּשְׁבִים֩ לְדָוִ֨ד עַל־כִּסְא֜וֹ וְאֶת־הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְאֶת־הַנְּבִיאִ֗ים וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֖ם שִׁכָּרֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Then you shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings who sit on David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
controles.kjv: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
controles.livre: Então dize-lhes: Assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que eu encherei de embriaguez todos os moradores desta terra, e aos reis que se sentam sobre o trono de Davi, e aos sacerdotes e aos profetas, e a todos os moradores de Jerusalém;

versos.hebraico: וְנִפַּצְתִּים֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶל־אָחִ֜יו וְהָאָב֧וֹת וְהַבָּנִ֛ים יַחְדָּ֖ו נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה לֹֽא־אֶחְמ֧וֹל וְלֹֽא־אָח֛וּס וְלֹ֥א אֲרַחֵ֖ם מֵהַשְׁחִיתָֽם׃ס

controles.web: I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, says Yahweh: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have compassion, that I should not destroy them.
controles.kjv: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the Lord: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.
controles.livre: E eu os despedaçarei um contra o outro, e juntamente os pais com os filhos, diz o SENHOR; não perdoarei, nem pouparei, nem terei compaixão; nada me impedirá de destruí-los.

versos.hebraico: שִׁמְע֥וּ וְהַאֲזִ֖ינוּ אַל־תִּגְבָּ֑הוּ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃

controles.web: Hear, and give ear; don’t be proud; for Yahweh has spoken.
controles.kjv: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the Lord hath spoken.
controles.livre: Escutai e ouvi: não sejais arrogantes, pois o SENHOR falou.

versos.hebraico: תְּנוּ֩ לַיהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֤ם כָּבוֹד֙ בְּטֶ֣רֶם יַחְשִׁ֔ךְ וּבְטֶ֛רֶם יִֽתְנַגְּפ֥וּ רַגְלֵיכֶ֖ם עַל־הָ֣רֵי נָ֑שֶׁף וְקִוִּיתֶ֤ם לְאוֹר֙ וְשָׂמָ֣הּ לְצַלְמָ֔וֶת ישית לַעֲרָפֶֽל׃

controles.web: Give glory to Yahweh your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and, while you look for light, he turns it into the shadow of death, and makes it gross darkness.
controles.kjv: Give glory to the Lord your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.
controles.livre: Dai glória ao SENHOR vosso Deus, antes que ele faça escurecer, e antes que vossos pés tropecem nos montes no meio da escuridão, e espereis luz, e ele a torne em sombra de morte e cause trevas.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם֙ לֹ֣א תִשְׁמָע֔וּהָ בְּמִסְתָּרִ֥ים תִּבְכֶּֽה־נַפְשִׁ֖י מִפְּנֵ֣י גֵוָ֑ה וְדָמֹ֨עַ תִּדְמַ֜ע וְתֵרַ֤ד עֵינִי֙ דִּמְעָ֔ה כִּ֥י נִשְׁבָּ֖ה עֵ֥דֶר יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: But if you will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret for your pride; and my eye shall weep bitterly, and run down with tears, because Yahweh’s flock is taken captive.
controles.kjv: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the Lord’s flock is carried away captive.
controles.livre: Mas se não ouvirdes isto, minha alma chorará em segredo por causa de vossa arrogância; e chorando amargamente, meus olhos se desfarão em lágrimas, porque o rebanho do SENHOR foi levado cativo.

versos.hebraico: אֱמֹ֥ר לַמֶּ֛לֶךְ וְלַגְּבִירָ֖ה הַשְׁפִּ֣ילוּ שֵׁ֑בוּ כִּ֤י יָרַד֙ מַרְאֲשׁ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם עֲטֶ֖רֶת תִּֽפְאַרְתְּכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Say to the king and to the queen mother, Humble yourselves, sit down; for your headdresses have come down, even the crown of your glory.
controles.kjv: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.
controles.livre: Dize ao rei e à rainha-mãe: Humilhai-vos, sentai-vos rebaixados; porque a coroa de vossa glória já caiu de vossas cabeças.

versos.hebraico: עָרֵ֥י הַנֶּ֛גֶב סֻגְּר֖וּ וְאֵ֣ין פֹּתֵ֑חַ הָגְלָ֧ת יְהוּדָ֛ה כֻּלָּ֖הּ הָגְלָ֥ת שְׁלוֹמִֽים׃ס

controles.web: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is no one to open them: Judah is carried away captive, all of it; it is wholly carried away captive.
controles.kjv: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
controles.livre: As cidades do Negueve  estão fechadas, e ninguém há que as abra; toda Judá foi levada, ela foi levada cativa por completo.

versos.hebraico: שאי עֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ וראי הַבָּאִ֖ים מִצָּפ֑וֹן אַיֵּ֗ה הָעֵ֨דֶר֙ נִתַּן־לָ֔ךְ צֹ֖אן תִּפְאַרְתֵּֽךְ׃

controles.web: Lift up your eyes, and see those who come from the north: where is the flock that was given you, your beautiful flock?
controles.kjv: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?
controles.livre: Levantai vossos olhos, e vede os que vêm do norte; onde está o rebanho que te foi dado, a ovelhas de tua glória?

versos.hebraico: מַה־תֹּֽאמְרִי֙ כִּֽי־יִפְקֹ֣ד עָלַ֔יִךְ וְ֠אַתְּ לִמַּ֨דְתְּ אֹתָ֥ם עָלַ֛יִךְ אַלֻּפִ֖ים לְרֹ֑אשׁ הֲל֤וֹא חֲבָלִים֙ יֹאחֱז֔וּךְ כְּמ֖וֹ אֵ֥שֶׁת לֵדָֽה׃

controles.web: What will you say, when he shall set over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you? shall not sorrows take hold of you, as of a woman in travail?
controles.kjv: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them to be captains, and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?
controles.livre: O que dirás quando ele te punir? Pois tu os ensinaste a serem príncipes e cabeça sobre ti. Por acaso as dores não te tomarão, como uma mulher em parto?

versos.hebraico: וְכִ֤י תֹאמְרִי֙ בִּלְבָבֵ֔ךְ מַדּ֖וּעַ קְרָאֻ֣נִי אֵ֑לֶּה בְּרֹ֧ב עֲוֺנֵ֛ךְ נִגְל֥וּ שׁוּלַ֖יִךְ נֶחְמְס֥וּ עֲקֵבָֽיִךְ׃

controles.web: If you say in your heart, Why are these things come on me? for the greatness of your iniquity are your skirts uncovered, and your heels suffer violence.
controles.kjv: And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, and thy heels made bare.
controles.livre: E quando disseres em teu coração: Por que estas coisas me aconteceram? A resposta é : Foi pela grandeza de tua maldade que tuas roupas foram descobertas, e foste violentada.

versos.hebraico: הֲיַהֲפֹ֤ךְ כּוּשִׁי֙ עוֹר֔וֹ וְנָמֵ֖ר חֲבַרְבֻּרֹתָ֑יו גַּם־אַתֶּם֙ תּוּכְל֣וּ לְהֵיטִ֔יב לִמֻּדֵ֖י הָרֵֽעַ׃

controles.web: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.
controles.kjv: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
controles.livre: Pode o negro  mudar a sua pele, ou o leopardo suas manchas? Assim também podeis vós fazer o bem, sendo tão acostumados a praticar o mal?

versos.hebraico: וַאֲפִיצֵ֖ם כְּקַשׁ־עוֹבֵ֑ר לְר֖וּחַ מִדְבָּֽר׃

controles.web: Therefore will I scatter them, as the stubble that passes away, by the wind of the wilderness.
controles.kjv: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.
controles.livre: Portanto eu os espalharei como os restos de palha que passam com o vento do deserto.

versos.hebraico: זֶ֣ה גוֹרָלֵ֧ךְ מְנָת־מִדַּ֛יִךְ מֵֽאִתִּ֖י נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ שָׁכַ֣חַתְּ אוֹתִ֔י וַֽתִּבְטְחִ֖י בַּשָּֽׁקֶר׃

controles.web: This is your lot, the portion measured to you from me, says Yahweh; because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.
controles.kjv: This is thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the Lord; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.
controles.livre: Isto é o que terás, a porção de tuas medidas que te reservo,  diz o SENHOR; pois tu te esqueceste de mim, e confiaste na mentira.

versos.hebraico: וְגַם־אֲנִ֛י חָשַׂ֥פְתִּי שׁוּלַ֖יִךְ עַל־פָּנָ֑יִךְ וְנִרְאָ֖ה קְלוֹנֵֽךְ׃

controles.web: Therefore will I also uncover your skirts on your face, and your shame shall appear.
controles.kjv: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.
controles.livre: Asim também eu descobrirei também tuas roupas até sobre teu rosto, e tua desonra ficará à mostra;

versos.hebraico: נִֽאֻפַ֤יִךְ וּמִצְהֲלוֹתַ֨יִךְ֙ זִמַּ֣ת זְנוּתֵ֔ךְ עַל־גְּבָעוֹת֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה רָאִ֖יתִי שִׁקּוּצָ֑יִךְ א֥וֹי לָךְ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לֹ֣א תִטְהֲרִ֔י אַחֲרֵ֥י מָתַ֖י עֹֽד׃פ

controles.web: I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries, and your neighing, the lewdness of your prostitution, on the hills in the field. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be made clean; how long shall it yet be?
controles.kjv: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when shall it once be?
controles.livre: Eu vi as tuas abominações: teus adultérios, teus relinchos, a maldade de tua prostituição sobre os morros no campo. Ai de ti, Jerusalém! Até quando continuarás sem te purificares?
